svg.title: Graphs of sine and cosine
svg.desc: The crimson solid curve y = sin x and the blue dashed curve y = cos x for x from -pi/2 to 2 pi, both waves between -1 and 1 with period 2 pi. Sine passes through (0, 0) and peaks at (pi/2, 1); cosine starts at (0, 1). Cosine is sine shifted pi/2 to the left.
